summary: Frontend-only retest of the Privacy Policy and Terms of Use links bug fix. Every requested scenario passed: going straight to /Privacy-Policy, /Terms-Of-Use and their lowercase versions shows the legal pages, not the home page. Privacy Policy: title, 'Last Updated: 18 October 2026', 32 h2 sections (1. INTRODUCTION to 32. CONTACT US), and one table with the headers Category/Examples/Principal purposes. Terms of Use: 17 h2 sections (1. INTRODUCTION to 17. CONTACT US), lettered items a.-i., and a mailto:privacy@beskarit.com link. The footer and cookie banner links (href /Privacy-Policy and /Terms-Of-Use, target _blank) open a new tab showing the right legal page. The portal popup does not open on legal pages and still opens on home. The Back to Home button goes to '/'. The browser back and forward buttons work. nav-products and the mobile Compliance menu item go from a legal page to home and scroll to the section (section top at 0). At 390px there is no page overflow (scrollWidth 390) and the table scrolls inside its overflow-x:auto container. No page errors.

issues: Minor: on first visit, the fixed cookie consent banner covers the footer bottom row (Privacy/Terms links) until the user accepts or rejects. This is expected banner behaviour, not a blocker.

critical_code_review_comments: App.js is about 1534 lines. Consider splitting it into components (Navigation, Footer, sections).
The portal popup timer only checks the pathname on first mount. If the user lands on a legal page and clicks Back to Home, the popup never shows in that session. That is acceptable, just noting it.
vercel.json has an SPA rewrite to index.html, so deep links will also work in production.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The legal pages are rendered by the client from frontend/src/legal/*.json through components/LegalPage.js, and App.js routes by window.location.pathname (case-insensitive). On the home page the cookie banner covers the footer links, so click Accept All before clicking the footer links. Popup testid: portal-preview-popup.
